narratorText: Quality assurance planning formalizes these concepts into actionable steps. Design reviews and architecture audits catch structural flaws early. Configuration management ensures that every change is tracked, preventing chaos in complex, multi-developer environments.

narratorText: Static analysis inspects code without running it, revealing defects before execution. This method saves resources by identifying logic errors early. It complements dynamic testing, which verifies behavior under real-world stress and boundary conditions.
title: Static vs Dynamic Testing

narratorText: Risk-based strategies prioritize testing where failures matter most. System and acceptance testing validate the entire user experience. This approach ensures that critical functions are rigorously checked, maximizing value while optimizing limited testing resources.
